backward_idea: A quantum field pulse should move through the same constrained electric degrees that dress a charged spinful carrier. Full-vector torque gives a field-dependent geometric charge rearrangement access to the actual transverse spin components, not only to an axial label.
geometry: 9 vertices (x,y,z)=(x,0,0),(x,1,0),(x,0,1), x=0,1,2; 12 oriented edges; two elementary loop planes in each of two cells. Fixed scaffold, not isotropic continuum.
basis: All allowed (active CAR bits, supplier CAR bits, r=0,1,2, four integer chord fluxes) at Nactive=1 including BOTH spin orientations, Nsupplier=1, |E_l|<=1; tree electric fields solved from B E+rho=0. Background charge -2 at vertex0. No discarded eigenstates inside this finite sector.
alignment: V_align=-alpha sum_{a=0,1,2} n_active(site=a) cos[2pi(a-r)/3], retained from the common 3D orientor law. It ties geometric charge motion to frame state; this finite alignment is supplied material, not emergent spherical binding.
hopping: T_active,l=-t_a sum_sigma c^dagger_{b,sigma} W_l c_{a,sigma}; T_supplier,l=-t_s m_b^dagger W_l m_a. Literal CAR signs and Gauss-preserving electric+1 translations, projected only at declared electric boundary. There is no B^2/Wilson energy term.
primitive_spin: S_a=(1/2)sum_x c_x^dagger sigma_a c_x, acts on actual CAR occupation bits. S_z is the FIXED laboratory occupation-difference observable, not a source channel or fitted Noether label. Primitive spin representation/CAR are unexplained inputs.
full_vector_frame: (L_a)_{bc}=-i epsilon_{abc} on r=0,1,2 Cartesian vector basis; [L_x,L_y]=iL_z. S dot L replaces old axial S_z L_n. Three-component frame/spin representations and their physical embedding are explicit inputs, not a derivation of nature's half-spin.
current_contact: H(a_l)=E^2/(2I)+material+sum_l(e^{ia_l}T_l+e^{-ia_l}T_l^dagger); J_l=-partial H/partial a_l=-i(T_l-T_l^dagger), K_l=partial^2 H/partial a_l^2=-(T_l+T_l^dagger). Same transfers generate evolution, current, contact, E_dot=J and rho_dot=-B J.
field_operators: W_f is the literal closed Gauss-preserving electric loop translation; F_f=(W_f-W_f^dagger)/(2i); loop E_f=sum_l f_l E_l/4. Fxy_left,Fxz_left and Fxy_right,Fxz_right are actual retained field degrees, not external spatial profiles.
reference: NEW full-vector ground g, selected by largest fixed Sz within its numerically degenerate ground eigenspace; all controls use this SAME g and same prepared seeds. Controls are explicit Hamiltonian quenches with individually evolving no-pulse baselines; no control-ground replacement or k-dependent energy repinning.
postselected_circular_packet: v_a=(F_a-<F_a>)g; psi_+/-=(v_xy +/- i v_xz)/sqrt(norm^2). Exact two-plane circular coefficients, finite-resolution packets, NOT helicity eigenstates or asymptotic photons. Their actual source Gram/normalized overlap and ground overlaps are measured. This is nonunitary preparation; far conditional observables can already differ at t=0 and are explicitly exposed, not credited as transport.
local_unitary_pulse: Q_+/-=Fxy_left +/- k E_xz_left, k=sqrt(<v_F|v_F>/<v_E|v_E>); psi=exp(-i eta Q)g. Hermitian local generator keeps norm1 and commutes with strict remote electric detector. These are coherent signed-quadrature pulses, NOT claimed pure helicity photons; their full ground component is retained.
event: psi_i(t)=exp[-i(H-E_ref)t]psi_i(0), by full sparse exponential action, not KH/linear-response kernel, no spectral truncation. E_ref is one common numerical phase shift only; physical energies always <H>.
strict_field_spin_measurement: D_R=1[E_10^2+E_11^2>0]; P_up=1/2+S_z, P_down=1/2-S_z. Four mutually orthogonal outcomes D_R P_up, D_R P_down, (1-D_R)P_up, (1-D_R)P_down sum I; probabilities measured on each actual evolved state, no conditional renormalization.
outgoing_source_measurement: V_out=[(Fxy_right-mean)g,(Fxz_right-mean)g]; Gram orthonormalization gives Q_out and P_out=Q_out Q_out^dagger. POVM {P_out P_up P_out,P_out P_down P_out,I-P_out} is positive and exhaustive even if P_out fails to commute with Sz. It means source-subspace filtering followed by primitive spin measurement, not exclusive free-photon counting.
charge_spin_motion: n_x, X=sum_x x n_x, V=i[H,X], body spin n_x S_a, spin current (S_a J_active,l+J_active,l S_a)/2 measured on identical waves. Electric energy and total H measured; finite lattice motion is retained but not free COM.
controls: Fixed-Hilbert complete cut removes active AND supplier transfer on edges3,4,5; current-coupling-off removes all active/supplier transfer; orientor-off removes torque, alignment, neutral hopping; old-axial fork reinstates S_z L_n. Same seeds, same source projector, separate same-H baseline each time.
limits: Electric truncation is severe and must be quantified, not hidden.
The graph has no continuum flux, asymptotic separation, Lorentz invariance or gapless massless bulk phase proof.
No absolute cross section, S-matrix, g=2, physical Noether half-spin derivation, proton or campaign closure is claimed.
Particle number is fixed; all states in the retained sector participate, but true electron/positron virtual-pair dynamics is not present.
Circular field source states can be nonorthogonal due the actual Gram; an actual rank2 does not by itself establish two asymptotic photon helicities.
